rules.title: Rent Control for Pre-1980 Multifamily Units
rules.requirement: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 are subject to Berkeley's rent control limits.

coverage.summary: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980

rules.exemptions: Golden Duplexes, owner-shared kitchen/bath units, certain ADUs, university dormitories, and nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980**

rules.title: Rent Control Exemption for New Construction
rules.requirement: Rental units built and receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 are exempt from Berkeley's rent control limits.

coverage.summary: Units built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980**

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Exemption for Golden Duplexes
rules.requirement: Duplexes that were owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently have an owner living in one of the units are exempt from Berkeley's Just Cause for Eviction protections.

coverage.summary: Duplexes that were owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently have an owner living in one of the units
coverage.owner_condition: duplex was owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently has an owner living in one of the units

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: “Golden Duplex”: duplex that was owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently has an owner living in one of the units

rules.title: Rent Control Exemption for Single-Family Homes with Post-1996 Tenancies
rules.requirement: Single-family homes with tenancies that began on or after January 1, 1996, are exempt from Berkeley's rent control limits.

coverage.summary: Single-family homes with tenancies that began on or after January 1, 1996

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996**
